basis: Computed by python -m src.router.build --weights-only --write-reliability from every train email (69542) and the Phase 9 thread rates on the train threads (results/score_rule_weights.csv)
rule: A rule that fires on more than 5% of the checked legitimate mail (ham) of a source (or of the real thread messages of a source), with 20 or more hits, counts 0.5; above 10% it counts 0. A rule that is not listed counts 1.
